attributes.name: data-for
attributes.description: ID of the target content element to analyze. Without it (or with an author-rendered <dl> inside) the component renders nothing and adopts the existing markup.

attributes.name: data-wpm
attributes.description: Words per minute for reading time (default 238, shared with page-info). Chinese/Japanese text is timed at 500 characters per minute.

attributes.name: data-show
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of stats to display, in fixed order: reading-time, word-count, last-modified. Unknown tokens are ignored. last-modified reads meta[name=last-modified], then meta[property=article:modified_time]; it is omitted when neither is present.

attributes.name: data-label-reading-time
attributes.description: Visually hidden dt label for the reading-time item.

attributes.name: data-label-word-count
attributes.description: Visually hidden dt label for the word-count item.

attributes.name: data-label-last-modified
attributes.description: Visually hidden dt label for the last-modified item.

attributes.name: data-label-min-read
attributes.description: Reading-time text template; {n} is the Intl-formatted minute value ("5 min"). Default "{n} read" for English documents, "{n}" otherwise.

attributes.name: data-label-words
attributes.description: Word-count text template; {n} is the Intl-formatted count. Per-plural overrides: data-label-words-zero/-one/-two/-few/-many (Intl.PluralRules category of the document language).

childAttributes.name: data-generated
childAttributes.description: Set by the component on the <dl> it renders itself. A <dl> without it is author/SSR markup and is adopted unchanged.

childAttributes.name: data-stats-ignore
childAttributes.description: Exclude this subtree from the word count (script, style, template, noscript, [hidden], [aria-hidden=true] and [inert] are always excluded).
